sponsor_or_proposer: National Oil Corp (NOC) and General Electricity Company of Libya (GECOL)
current_state: Pre-concept. On 16 Sep 2025 NOC chairman Masoud Suleiman and GECOL met and 'explored the possibility of establishing platforms for supplying liquefied gas to the plants to avoid unit shutdowns, as well as building additional fuel storage tanks.' No site, no named developer, no capacity, no FSRU named, no FID/FEED/MOU/tender — the parties only 'agreed to strengthen cooperation.' It is ambiguous whether 'liquefied gas' means LNG regasification or LPG; the Libya country note flags that recent Brega activity is LPG/gas-distribution, not LNG.
missing_threshold_elements: sponsor (only NOC/GECOL as conveners, no terminal developer/SPV); location (no site named); concrete step (only an exploratory discussion, no MOU/FEED/permit/site selection); also unclear if LNG vs LPG.
